verdict.rationale: Kimi is a consumer AI assistant with a membership subscription, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a setting, policy, or toggle controlling whether conversations are used for model training. The help topics cover memory, search, and agents, but none address training-data usage.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
